definitions.explanation: The maximum possible score on a test or evaluation.
Figuratively, something that is perfect or ideal in every way.

examples.japanese: テストで{満点|まんてん}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I got a perfect score on the test.

examples.japanese: {満点|まんてん}の{笑顔|えがお}だ。
{百点|ひゃくてん}{満点|まんてん}で{九十八|きゅうじゅうはち}{点|てん}だった。

notes:
COMPOUND: {満|まん} (full) + {点|てん} (points)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {満点|まんてん}を{取|と}る (get a perfect score)
- {百点|ひゃくてん}{満点|まんてん} (100 points being perfect)
- {満点|まんてん}の + Noun (perfect ~)

RELATED SCORING TERMS:
- {零点|れいてん}/{0点|ぜろてん} (zero points)
- {合格点|ごうかくてん} (passing score)
- {平均点|へいきんてん} (average score)
- {最高点|さいこうてん} (highest score)
